facts.text: Through the Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE), eligible undergraduate students from participant western states and territories pay 1.5 times the Idaho resident tuition rate across all fields of study.

sources.title: Western Undergraduate Exchange | Idaho State University
sources.quote: WUE students pay 1.5 times the Idaho resident tuition instead of full non-resident tuition plus resident tuition, for a tremendous cost savings.

sources.title: Western Undergraduate Exchange | Idaho State University
sources.quote: All fields of study at Idaho State University are WUE eligible
